#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long solve(int n, int m) {
    if (n == 1) {
        return (m / 6 * 3 + max(m % 6 - 3, 0)) << 1;
    } else if (n == 2) {
        int special = m == 2 ? 0 : m == 3 ? 4 : m == 7 ? 12 : m << 1;
        return special;
    } else {
        return 1LL * n * m / 2 * 2;
    }
}

int main() {
    int a, b;
    cin >> a >> b;
    if (a > b) swap(a, b);
    cout << solve(a, b) << endl;
    return 0;
}
